name: 3D MiniGolf: Makeover-Edition
summary:
Get ready to explore over 50 newly designed courses that are not only challenging but also super fun!

There are three fantastic worlds to choose from - a beautiful green park, a camping site in the mountains and a dreamy sandy beach.

Choose between two exciting game modes: take on the challenge in Challenge mode or compete against the AI or your friends in Tournament mode. You can also compete with up to 4 players in local multiplayer mode.

Receive medals for your great achievements - such as an impressive hole-in-one! Show off your skills and leave the competition behind.

So grab your club and bring the whole family - the ultimate MiniGolf experience awaits!
